merge.metaTitle: Merge PDF – Combine PDF files online for free
merge.metaDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into one document in seconds. Put the files in order, then download. Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
merge.lead: Combine PDFs into one file in the order you want. Everything runs in your browser, so your files never leave your device.
merge.cardText: Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
howTo: Select or drop two or more PDF files.
Drag the files, or use the arrows, to set their order.
Optionally name the merged file, then click Merge PDF.

faq.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Merging happens entirely in your browser, and your files are never sent to our servers.

faq.q: How many files can I merge?
faq.a: Up to {maxFiles} PDF files with a combined size of up to {maxSize}.

faq.q: Are bookmarks and form fields kept?

faq.q: Does it work on my phone?

split.metaTitle: Split PDF – Extract pages from a PDF online for free
split.metaDescription: Pull the pages you need out of a PDF and save them as a new file. Type pages like 1-3, 5, then download. Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
split.lead: Choose the pages you need, such as 1-3, 5, and save them as a new PDF. Everything runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
split.cardText: Extract the pages you need from a PDF into a new file.
howTo: Select or drop a PDF file.
Enter the pages to keep, such as 1-3, 5, or 8- for page 8 to the end.
Optionally name the new file, then click Extract pages.

faq.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Your PDF is split entirely in your browser and is never sent to our servers.

faq.q: How do I choose the pages?
faq.a: Type page numbers and ranges separated by commas. For example, 1-3, 5, 8- extracts pages 1 to 3, page 5, and page 8 to the end. The pages keep their original order.

faq.q: Can I split a PDF into several files at once?
faq.a: Not yet. For now, run the tool once for each part you need.

faq.q: How large can the PDF be?
faq.a: Up to {maxSize}, the limit for processing in your browser.

faq.q: Can I split a password-protected PDF?
faq.a: Not yet. Remove the password first, then try again.

faq.q: Will the quality change? Are bookmarks kept?
faq.a: Pages are copied as they are, so text, images and fonts are not re-compressed. Bookmarks and fillable form fields may not carry over.
